text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(—Once upon a time. Back when I was so 
little, I couldn't even say my own age. 
And yet—strangely enough, I still 
remember.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Relative
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go, Yukino-chan, eat up! It's 
sweets we bought in Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(My favorite treat whenever my aunts and 
uncles came to visit—gorgeous, beautiful 
sweets packed neatly inside paper boxes.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(The living room, livelier than usual. 
Eating those sweets at our own leisurely 
pace while looking out at the garden, they 
tasted so wonderfully sweet—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (—It tasted like pure happiness.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
[Event Title Logo Display *Placement up to 
implementation]

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Pastry Chef
text_block_list.text:
—Our Valentine's Fair is going on right 
now! Please, take a look!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Look at all these gorgeous sweets 
lined up, Cafe-san! Every year when 
Valentine's Day draws near, the town gets 
so lively, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, sorry for gettin' sidetracked. The 
place I'm "escorting" you to today is just 
a little further down the road.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Okay... 
Fufu... I'm looking forward to your 
recommendation, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I really hope you'll like it... 
Right this way, please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hello there~ Good afternoon, Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well now, if it isn't Yukino-chan. Oh my, 
and you brought a friend along today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon... 
...What lovely wagashi. Tsubaki-mochi, 
uguisu-mochi...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, don't they look delicious? Go ahead 
and pick whatever you like! It's my treat 
today!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Of course, of course! You're always 
treatin' me to coffee and sweets, 
Cafe-san. I gotta look cool and return the 
favor once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. 
I will gladly take you up on your offer 
then, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll give you a discount. ...Oh, 
that's right. 
If you're having tea, feel free to use the 
tatami room in the back.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
As expected, traditional Japanese sweets 
go wonderfully with green tea... 
The harmony of sweet and bitter... is 
truly profound.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~ It's such a comforting taste. 
...Somehow, it kinda reminds me of the old 
days.
Excuse meeeeeee—!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds like another regular has 
arrived. Well then... 
You two take your time and relax.

text_block_list.name: Yukino & Cafe
text_block_list.text: Coming!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. There's really somethin' nice 
about this, isn't there? 
Things like this, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Japanese sweets are lovely once in 
a while.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. That's true too, but... 
Having tea with you, Cafe-san, it just 
makes me feel so at ease.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I feel the same way...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Excuse meee!! 
I'd like some sakura mochi, pleaseeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... A whole bunch! Ten of 
them! 
Ten, please!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, always full of energy, 
aren't you... 
...Come to think of it, you've been coming 
here for a long time now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Your sakura mochi is of 
top-grade perfection! A model 
establishment that keeps them in stock all 
year round! I shall remain a loyal patron 
forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...That's wonderful to hear. Thank you, 
dear...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Chowa? Is something the matter...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Fashion. 
It is far more than just dressing 
stylishly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The 'radiance' that slumbers within 
everyone... Polishing it to perfection and 
escorting it onto the main stage—that is 
what fashion coordination is all about!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then—let's begin today's fashion 
consultation. 
Our guest for today is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Professor Flight! 
I'm in your hands!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine♪ 
Now, if you'll excuse me for a moment... 
Hmm, hmm.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You've got that professional look 
in your eyes already!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, coordination starts with 
observation. 
Building an image from there is my 
personal philosophy!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Structurally, you have a 'straight' 
body frame. 
Your usual fashion consists of boyish 
American casual, I see.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However—there is still so much 
undiscovered 'radiance' sleeping inside 
you, Ticket-san! 
Now, let's start trying things on right 
away!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First, let's go for a handsome look! Edgy 
leather pants 
paired with a tailored jacket that fits 
like a glove!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next, a complete transformation! A satin 
wrap skirt 
with a refined high-gauge knit for a 
ladylike finish!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If we're aiming for a feminine feel, we'll 
want to show off your ankles— 
How about a crisp shirt dress with a 
structured silhouette?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, this is amazing! This is 
me? That's me too?! 
Are all of these really me~?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you like them? 
And while we're at it, I dressed up to 
match you, Ticket-san, like this♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—I bought so much stuff! Thank you, 
Flight!! 
I'm so, so glad you came with me!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You really are the academy's fashion 
leader! 
Everyone knows that if you need style 
advice, Flight's the one to ask!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I heard someone even asked you for advice 
on their racing outfit design the other 
day! 
Honestly, I totally get why~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all...! I simply want 
everyone 
to bring out their own unique 'radiance.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The beauty that lies hidden within each 
and every person... 
Being able to help polish that is a true 
joy for me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So... so professional~!! 
That sounded straight out of a documentary 
interview, Flight!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right! As thanks for today! 
My treat, so is there anything you feel 
like eating?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't worry about it! I only do 
this because I love it—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wh... Whaaaaat in the wooooorld?!?!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Was that... Bakushin O-chan's voice just 
now?!
